subject: AWS CPPO: reseller evidence intake + sandbox capacity routing matrix
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jmills@cloudforge.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudForge Resell Ops <ops@cloudforge.io>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO intake - evidence & sandbox quota

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick connect yesterday. We scoped the CPPO request for Acme Corp and hit a couple of blocking items on our side that we'll need Redwood to confirm before we can move the offer to activation. Can you help with two things: 1) a short evidence matrix (SOC2, KMS/HSM attestation, data residency note) that we can attach to our marketplace listing and 2) a sandbox capacity allocation for two downstream reseller demo accounts (Acme-PoC1, Acme-PoC2) for the first 90 days?

Attached: sandbox-quota-request-20280622.pdf (requested quotas + sample tenant names).

High level timeline: Acme wants to sign the private offer next week (HUB-8342) but will not push live until we can confirm the evidence bundle and a routing/lead flow for demos. Appreciate any quick pointers or owners.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, GTM Partnerships
CloudForge Resell

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jmills@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO intake - evidence & sandbox quota

Jordan — putting the team on this. Short answers up front: 1) We can produce a focused evidence bundle for CPPO that includes a SOC 2 attestation excerpt, KMS integration diagram (customer key flow), and a notes doc on our EU/US residency controls (suitable for marketplace listing). 2) Sandbox quotas: we can allocate two demo tenants with 50k token monthly budget each and a 1 GPU reserved demo instance for 90 days.

Actions I'll take today:
- Vanessa: coordinate the technical evidence pack and attach the checklist.
- Soojin: define sandbox instance type and provide the routing matrix for demo traffic (how lead routing ties back to CloudForge when demos convert).
- Laura: review the evidence wording for any legal/regulatory redlines.

Deliverables ETA: evidence bundle and routing matrix by Monday EOD (2028-06-25). Will upload to the shared drive and send DocuSign if needed for the dedicated demo instances.

Ben
Senior Channel Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Mills <jmills@cloudforge.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudForge Resell Ops <ops@cloudforge.io>
Date: Sun, 24 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO intake - evidence & sandbox quota

Perfect, that timeline works. Two follow-ups from our side: 1) Acme requires SSO metadata for the demo env so their IT team can pre-seed user access — can you provide an SP metadata XML or OIDC redirect URI? 2) For routing matrix, we need a simple CSV that maps incoming demo leads -> CloudForge SDR queue -> Redwood demo tenant (so we can instrument conversion events). Our ops team also asked if the routing can fallback to a shared demo tenant if reserved instances are saturated.

If you prefer, I can draft the CSV template and send it back. Also, can you mark any evidence items that require a legal attestation or a counter-signature?

Thanks — Jordan

Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO intake - evidence & sandbox quota (routing matrix + deliverables)

Jordan — attaching the initial artifacts and answering questions below.

Attachments: CPPO-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx; redirect-routing-matrix-v1.csv

1) SSO / demo access: we support SAML SP metadata and OIDC. For the reserved demo tenants we will provide an SP metadata XML per tenant. For the shared fallback tenant use the OIDC redirect URI: https://demo.redwood.com/oauth/callback. We'll put the specific SP metadata files in the shared Drive folder (link below).

2) Routing matrix: attached CSV maps: demo_lead_source -> cloudforge_queue_id -> redwood_demo_tenant_id -> fallback_tenant_id. We will trigger queue overflow fallback if reserved GPU usage exceeds 85% for 10m window. The CSV includes the CloudForge queue IDs and suggested event names for HubSpot mapping.

3) Legal attestation: Laura reviewed the evidence bundle; the SOC2 excerpt and the residency note are informational and do not require counter-signature. The KMS diagram is descriptive; any contractual key escrow or HSM onboarding beyond standard CPPO language would need a separate SOW.

Next steps: Jordan to confirm acceptance of quotas and routing logic. Ben to approve the demo provisioning DocuSign for the two reserved tenants. I'll upload SP metadata and the final CSV to Drive and post the link to the HubSpot deal.

Drive: drive.google.com/drive/folders/CPPO-Evidence-CloudForge
HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8342
DocuSign (provisioning): https://na1.docusign.net/prepare?token=0a1b2c

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
